claims.claim: Xbox one with one pad for sell
claims.evidence: Witness could not confirm brand or model from photos; no logo, label, or model text visible.
No games, discs, or cases visible in either photo.
No adaptor/power brick shown in either photo; issue is self-reported only.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: Internal condition and repair history cannot be seen from exterior photos.
No close-up of rear/side ports provided.
Only a single controller is visible in Photo 1; 'pads' (plural) not shown.

risks.proof: Clear photo of console front/rear logo, model number sticker, or power brick branding
risks.if_unproven: priced as unbranded/unidentified console, not confirmed Xbox One

risks.risk: Adapter is faulty or missing, console may not power on reliably
risks.proof: Video of console powering on fully with the adapter in question

risks.risk: Second controller or extra pads not actually included
Games claimed (6 incl. FC) may not be included or may be digital-only
risks.proof: Photo of physical game discs/cases or screenshot of installed library
risks.if_unproven: priced as console-only, no games included

risks.risk: Ports and HDMI/power connectors condition unknown
risks.proof: Close-up photo of rear port panel
risks.if_unproven: priced as ports unverified, possible damage

risks.proof: Photo of console settings/storage screen or bottom label

risks.risk: Receipt authenticity and relevance (UK receipt for Nigeria sale) unverified
risks.proof: Clear photo of the receipt with date, model, and retailer
risks.if_unproven: priced as no proof of purchase/warranty

risks.risk: Controller battery type/condition and connectivity unverified

proof_requests: Photo of console rear panel showing all ports and any model/serial sticker
Photo or video of the power adapter, showing the fault
Video of console powering on and loading a game, with controller connected
Photo of all included games/discs laid out
Photo of the UK receipt, legible
Photo showing both controllers if more than one is included
response.reason: Witness confirms a game console with one controller, so it can be priced at worst case as an unverified-brand, adapter-faulty, single-controller unit pending further proof.
